import sys

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    size = 2 * n - 1
    
    for i in range(size):
        row = []
        for j in range(size):
            d1 = abs(i - (n - 1))
            d2 = abs(j - (n - 1))
            val = n - max(d1, d2)
            row.append(str(val))
        print(' '.join(row))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
